areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Specialized care for women is directly related, with indicator and target but no timeframe; negligible resource share and tiny population reach give reduced impact; integrated care solution seen as efficient.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Urban infrastructure objective directly related; works component with mobility and public facilities; indicators and targets (one without timeframe); a moderate resource share; moderate impact and efficient solutions.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Objective of public parks for sport and leisure is directly related, with indicator lacking a timeframe; small resource share, negligible expected increase in park area, efficiency not demonstrated.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Flooding-reduction objective directly related; macro-drainage works with indicator lacking a timeframe; moderate impact from a modest reduction in affected properties; efficient solutions.

areas.name: Labor

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Budget-balance and governance objectives directly related; refinancing component takes half the resources; liquidity indicator and target; moderate impact because only one external debt is refinanced; efficient cash-flow rebalancing.
